Jharkhand men 108 enbulens karmachari vetan bhugtan ke sath apni kaee mangon ko lekar anishchitkalin hartal par chale gae hain... karmachariyon ka aarop hai ki, julaee mahine se unhen pura vetan nahin mil raha hai... kahin vetan ka bhugtan lanbit hai to kahin vetan men manmani katauti ki ja rahi hai... iske alava karmachariyon ne naukri ki suraksha, bima, pieph, eeesaaaee aur any suvidhaon ki bhi mang uthaee hai...
